name: Sufi Shrines of Pakistan
description: A bilingual (English/Urdu) interactive web map and open dataset of Sufi shrines and multi-faith sacred sites across Pakistan. Covers Muslim shrines (dargahs, mazars), Hindu temples (mandirs), and Sikh gurdwaras. Built with Vite 5, React 18, and TypeScript; data licensed ODbL-1.0; code licensed MIT.
abstract: This project combines a schema-validated Frictionless Data Package (109+ sites; coordinates, descriptions, provenance) with a static-site web application featuring bilingual EN/Urdu support, RTL layout, dark mode, and an interactive Leaflet map. Designed for Harvard computational humanities research and Zenodo/Dataverse deposit.
